answers.text: "past the 70% climax line": that is a base-reader's test, not mine (C16). My test is trend plus a new high: W, D and H1 all HH/HL, D close 15.02 is 0.99% under 20-day high 15.17, ema_order 9>21 on all three. A new high is the entry, not the warning; my exit is the danger signal (C7), not a climax line.

trigger.plain: An hourly candle closes above the 52-week closing high: the new high prints on strength, never a dip buy.

decisions.wrong_if: A fade of 1x atr_14d from the day's high (my translation, not Livermore's 6 points), or D swing stops being HH/HL.
decisions.reason: C5/C16: established uptrend at its high, W/D/H1 swing HH/HL, D close 15.02 above ema9 13.1421 and ema21 11.9834, H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 83.9. Extension is a weight, not a veto; a lone name in its group, so no second-name confirmation (C14). Exit is the danger signal.

declarations: danger_signal_threshold: TRANSLATED via atr_14d, my translation, not Livermore's 6 points (C7, C18-C20)
state_analogue: mp_state/mp_accel_state read as my six-column classifier's modern equivalent, not identical (C18)
fill_difficulty: NOT_SERVED (day_vol is a proxy only)
